missingmed: Mediation Analysis with Multiple Imputation for Missing Data

Source: R/missingmed-package.R
missingmed-package.Rd

missingmed runs SEM-based mediation analysis across multiply imputed datasets and pools with Rubin's rules. It is a thin orchestration layer: it fits each imputation with medfit and delegates inference to RMediation.

S7 pipeline

  • set_md_mediation() -> MDMediationData: imputed data + mediation spec

  • run() -> MDMediationFit: a list of named medfit::MediationData, one per imputation

  • pool() -> MDMediationResult: Rubin's-rules pooled named medfit::MediationData

  • infer(): indirect-effect CI (RMediation::ci_mediation_data()) or D4-stacked MBCO

  • per_imputation_list(): per-imputation fits for MBCO (which does not commute with Rubin's rules)

Deprecated S4 API

set_sem(), run_sem(), and pool_sem() are superseded by the S7 pipeline above and kept for one release cycle.
